# Rexxon AI

> Rexxon AI is a real-time B2B buying signals platform that monitors 10M+ companies for hiring, funding, leadership, compliance, earnings, and tech-expansion events, then drafts AI personalized outreach to verified decision-maker contacts.

## What Rexxon AI does

- Detects real-time buying signals from job posts (LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever, Indeed), funding announcements (Crunchbase, SEC EDGAR), leadership changes, earnings calls, compliance events (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), and tech stack expansions.
- Generates AI-drafted personalized cold emails and multi-touch outreach sequences using Gemini and GPT-5 models.
- Provides verified contact data (email, phone, LinkedIn) for hiring managers and decision-makers tied to each signal.
- Delivers signals via dashboard, email digest (daily/weekly), and Slack notifications scoped to user-defined territories.

## Who it's for

- B2B SDRs, Account Executives, VP of Sales, RevOps leaders, and outbound sales agencies selling to mid-market and enterprise.
- Best fit for cybersecurity, devtools, GRC/compliance, fintech, MLOps, HR tech, and SaaS vendors.
